description: Power in four windows, light session (bench_power.py): typing letters into the terminal in view at a person's pace (typing), one static Chromium tab in view and idle (tab1), the same with every window hidden (tab1-hidden) and a page that scrolls itself (scroll). Each window is settled, then measured: powermetrics' package, CPU and GPU power once a second (pool.json's privileged command, decision D3), and the energy and wakeups of the app and every process it owns. A host without the powermetrics right refuses with sudo's reason and writes nothing.
